entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • calling Microsoft.Build.Evaluation.Project.FromProjectRootElement leads to exception being thrown #54554
  • 10.0.300 regression: dotnet watch crashes with "An item with the same key has already been added" #54552
  • File-based apps don't re-evaluate during `--no-build` unlike project-based apps #54551
  • [11.0.100-preview.5.26277.119] pomodoroflavors build failed with error CS0433: The type 'ServiceCollection' exists in both 'Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions' and 'Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection' #54550

Closed

  • LLM env detection should detect copilot terminal in VSCode #54348
  • Missing libraries when using CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies #53854
  • Broken and unrepairable workload state #53927
  • Default VerificationExcludePatterns use single * instead of ** — broken for nested obj/bin paths #54274
  • file-based-programs should also support assembly import #49129
    11.0-preview6
  • dotnet build: Adding -tl:off prevents file-based app detection; breaks with spurious warning and MSBuild error #54540
